title: 3 AI Stocks With Massive Upside
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: A collaboration hosted with Rachel for The Motley Fool and Couch Investor, presenting three AI stocks for a watch or buy list. Rachel, a long-term Alphabet shareholder, picks Alphabet first: AI is monetising the core search, advertising and cloud businesses rather than cannibalising search, with second-quarter 2026 revenue up 24%, search and other advertising up 17%, Google Cloud up 82% with a $514 billion backlog, the Gemini app at 950 million monthly users and Gemini Enterprise used by nearly 90% of the Fortune 100; heavy capex and regulatory risk are the offsets, and she calls it a continued compelling buy, which Couch endorses. Couch's own pick is Nebius, the ex-Yandex team headquartered in Amsterdam renting out AI compute: second-quarter revenue of $582 million, up 454% year over year, ARR of $3 billion, adjusted EBITDA margin around 41% and a roughly $40 billion contracted backlog including Microsoft and Meta, with a Token Factory strategy built through the Tavily, Agon AI, Clarify and Infrise acquisitions to raise GPU utilisation and move toward higher-margin enterprise cloud; execution, permits and huge capex are the risks. Rachel closes with Arista Networks, the Ethernet networking layer for AI clusters, presented as a watch-list name: fiscal second-quarter revenue above $3 billion, 2026 guidance raised to $12.6 billion and an AI revenue target of about $3.6 billion, offset by hyperscaler customer concentration. Calls made, attributed to Couch Investor as the watched creator: GOOGL BUY (Rachel's pick, endorsed), NBIS CONDITIONAL_BUY reiterated, ANET UNCERTAIN (watch list only). Auto-captions garble some company names and figures, including Nebius and several acquisition names.

calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (prior Couch GOOGL BUY; no flip) — collaboration with Rachel (The Motley Fool and Couch Investor): Rachel, a long-term Alphabet shareholder, calls Alphabet a 'continued compelling buy' and Couch explicitly agrees, saying Google/Alphabet is a name he would put on any list. Q2 2026: revenue +24% YoY, search/ads +17%, Google Cloud +82% with $514B backlog; Gemini app 950M MAU, Gemini Enterprise used by ~90% of Fortune 100.
calls.base_case: AI is layered onto search/cloud rather than cannibalising search; search is now ~50% of revenue as Cloud grows faster and becomes extremely profitable; funded by the profitable ads business.
calls.bull_case: TPUs reduce reliance on outside suppliers; Waymo leads US autonomy and is expanding internationally; Isomorphic Labs and other Other Bets add optionality.
calls.bear_case: Heavy AI capex pressures near-term profitability (stock fell after a recent earnings report on spend); regulatory risk is a permanent background factor.
calls.collab_byline: The Motley Fool and Couch Investor
